# streamtime_fleet_node_pools (Data Source)

Lists a fleet's node pools. Streamtime manages node pools with the fleet; they are read-only here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "streamtime_fleet_node_pools" "prod" {
  fleet = "prod"
}

output "node_count" {
  value = sum([for p in data.streamtime_fleet_node_pools.prod.node_pools : p.size])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fleet` (String) The fleet's identifier.

### Read-Only

- `node_pools` (Attributes List) The fleet's node pools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pools))

<a id="nestedatt--node_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pools`

Read-Only:

- `metadata` (String) Details of the pool, as JSON.
- `size` (Number) Number of nodes.
